items.prompt: Why can minimum event counts be risky for rare high-value requests?

options.text: They discard only statistically unimportant requests
options.why: A rare request can be high-impact even when the chosen minimum sample count suppresses its alert.

options.text: They can suppress serious low-traffic failures
options.why: Alert policy must reflect user impact.

items.explanation: The toy rule is not a universal paging policy.
